description: Curated board pages (most relevant boards per family). `match` is a regex over catalogue fields (board_rev, name, fpga, ulx3s_path) after removing 'not <board>' phrases; `page` = optional data/pages/<slug>.json used as the page body.

families.title: ECP5 boards
families.description: Lattice ECP5 (LFE5U/LFE5UM): 12k–85k LUTs, DSP blocks, SERDES on 5G parts; open flow yosys + nextpnr-ecp5 + ecppack.

families.title: iCE40 UP5K boards
families.description: Lattice iCE40 UltraPlus UP5K: 5.3k LUTs, 128 KB SPRAM, DSP, RGB driver; open flow yosys + nextpnr-ice40 + icepack. Cores use SB_* primitives.

families.title: iCE40 HX8K / HX4K boards
families.description: Lattice iCE40 HX8K/HX4K (HX4K is the HX8K die, built with --hx8k --package ...:4k): 7.7k LUTs; open flow yosys + nextpnr-ice40 (older designs: arachne-pnr).

boards.name: ULX3S
boards.description: The main board of this collection: 32 MB SDR SDRAM, GPDI (HDMI) port, ESP32, US1 FT231X + US2 direct USB, SD card, MAX11125 ADC, OLED header, 56 GPIO.

boards.name: ULX4M
boards.description: ULX3S successor in Raspberry Pi CM4 module format; most ULX3S designs port with the ulx4m_v002.lpf constraint file.

boards.name: OrangeCrab
boards.description: Feather-format ECP5 board with DDR3 and native USB; DFU bootloader.

boards.name: Colorlight 5A-75B/E, i5, i9
boards.full_name: Colorlight LED-receiver cards and SODIMM modules
boards.description: Cheap ECP5 boards with gigabit Ethernet PHYs and SDRAM, repurposed from LED-panel receivers.

boards.name: IcePi Zero
boards.description: Raspberry Pi Zero-sized ECP5 board with HDMI, SDRAM and USB; many ULX3S retro ports target it.

boards.name: iCESugar-Pro
boards.description: SODIMM-format ECP5 module with SDRAM and HDMI on the carrier.

boards.name: iCEBreaker
boards.description: The reference open-source UP5K board, with PMOD ports and many workshop examples.

boards.name: UPduino
boards.description: Low-cost UP5K board in DIP format.

boards.name: iCESugar
boards.description: Small UP5K board with a drag-and-drop programmer.

boards.name: Fomu
boards.description: UP5K board that fits inside a USB port; foboot DFU bootloader.

boards.name: pico-ice
boards.description: RP2040 microcontroller plus UP5K; the RP2040 programs the FPGA (DFU on the MCU).

boards.name: iCE40-HX8K Breakout
boards.description: Lattice's HX8K evaluation board, target of many IceStorm-era examples.

boards.name: BlackIce II / Mx
boards.full_name: myStorm BlackIce II and BlackIce Mx
boards.description: HX4K + STM32 board (the MCU loads the FPGA); retro computers by hoglet67 and lawrie's examples.

boards.name: iceFUN
boards.description: Small HX8K board used by mikeakohn's CPU projects.

boards.name: Olimex iCE40HX8K-EVB
boards.description: Olimex HX8K evaluation board with SRAM; xv6 RISC-V computer and Apple-1 ports.

boards.name: IcoBoard
boards.description: HX8K Raspberry Pi HAT with SRAM; icosoc SoC generator.

boards.name: ECPIX-5
boards.fpga: LFE5UM5G-45F or LFE5UM5G-85F (ECP5-5G, with SERDES), BG554
boards.fpga_evidence: LiteX / Amaranth board files, see the TinyFPGA EX / ECPIX-5 / Cynthion survey
boards.description: ECP5-5G board with DDR3, RGMII Ethernet, HDMI (IT6613), a SATA port driven by LiteSATA over the SERDES, SD, ULPI USB and 8 PMODs; programmed with openFPGALoader -b ecpix5.

boards.name: Cynthion
boards.fpga_evidence: cynthion board files (r0.1–r1.4), see the TinyFPGA EX / ECPIX-5 / Cynthion survey
boards.description: USB 2.0 test instrument: three ULPI high-speed USB PHYs, HyperRAM, 2 PMODs; programmed through the Apollo debug MCU. Home of the LUNA USB gateware (analyzer, Facedancer, USB host experiments).
